# … 呀 · *… aa3*

**Meaning:** friendly softener for questions and replies · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Sentence-final particles

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

Sentence-final particles add tone of voice. 呀 makes questions and short answers sound warm rather than blunt. 你去邊度？ is abrupt; 你去邊度呀？ is friendly.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **你去邊度呀？** |
| Jyutping | nei5 heoi3 bin1 dou6 aa3? |
| Yale | néih heui bīn douh a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄝㄧ⁵ ㄏㆤㄧ³ ㄅㄧㄣ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ⁶ ㄚ³? |
| English | Where are you going? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **係呀。** |
| Jyutping | hai6 aa3. |
| Yale | haih a. |
| Bopomofo | ㄏㄜㄧ⁶ ㄚ³. |
| English | Yes, that's right. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **好呀！** |
| Jyutping | hou2 aa3! |
| Yale | hóu a! |
| Bopomofo | ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄚ³! |
| English | Sure! Sounds good! |
